_doc: Public example corpus for wgvp. Nothing here is redistributed: fetch_examples.py downloads each source from YouTube on your machine (or takes a copy you already have), cuts the listed segment, finds the walker marked by `subject_hints` (frame index in the cut, x, y pixel of the hips) with the pipeline's own tracker and settings, and fabricates a WearGait-style recording CSV whose pelvis accelerometer is that walker's own vertical motion (plus displacement-domain noise at SNR 2, differentiated twice), so the pipeline can be run on real footage without any real IMU. `offset_s` is the video time at which the fabricated IMU recording starts; it is what the sync stage must recover. All three videos are listed as healthy-walking sources in the GAVD dataset.

examples.name: EX01
examples.about: '6 Minute Walk test' instructional video: one person stands at the near end of a long, empty corridor for two seconds, then walks away from the camera for 13 s, the geometry of a gait lab's along-walkway view (the body shrinks four-fold as it recedes).
examples.expect: the easy case: a single walker, one fragment, a stand-then-walk onset for the coarse match, high confidence; the sync offset of 1.0 s recovered within a frame

examples.name: EX02
examples.about: 'Shuttle walk test' demonstration: one person walks away down a corridor and back while two staff members stand in the frame, one of them very close to the camera and a third of the frame tall.
examples.expect: the clinic-like case: the walker is chosen over the two standing staff, including the large one; the walker's fragments across the far turn are accepted at one lag; coverage is partial because the walker is far down the corridor part of the time

examples.name: EX03
examples.about: Public plaza footage with hundreds of pedestrians (60 fps source, cut to 30 fps); the subject is one passer-by crossing the frame right to left over 14 s.
examples.expect: the hard case: one walker among about 300 track fragments, with a reference that has no stand/walk structure; the walker should be found, `low` rather than `high` confidence is possible
